newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN VAN ROMPUY BEST MAN TO SUCCEED DEHAENE.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN VAN ROMPUY BEST MAN TO SUCCEED DEHAENE.

text.p: Belgian Budget Minister Herman Van Rompuy is the most likely successor to Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene, Justice Minister Stefaan De Clerck was quoted on Monday as saying.

"If the CVP ever nominates a successor to Dehaeene, it will evidently be Van Rompuy. In this complex country one needs all knowledge one can have about linguistic and financial-economical issues, he is the best man," De Clerck told Belgian daily De Morgen in an interview.
Dehaene himself -- who does not want a third term when his mandate ends in 1999 -- recently named De Clerck as a possible successor.
De Clerck's cool handling of a series of murder and paedophile scandals has earnied him wide acclaim in recent months.
Van Rompuy too has often been mentioned as a possible future prime minister.
